provenance.paper_title: GEMS: Agent-Native Multimodal Generation with Memory and Skills

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Agent Memory persistently stores factual states across the iterative generation trajectory.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Hierarchically compressed summaries preserve a global view of the optimization process while reducing redundancy.
Trajectory experience is compressed into hierarchical summaries. For GEMS, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of trajectory factual state.
Repeated generation traces are distilled into reusable experiential memory. For GEMS, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of trajectory factual state.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (trajectory factual state) changes through episodic or hierarchical summarization, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
